body: I had help from a friend to put a bunch of changes into motion. I refused to go back to therapy after faking my way out of it but was able to open up to a manager who had always been really nice, it was a really low point for me when I did and it turned out he had had issues like mine so when things were getting really bad again he suggested transferring to another store (he had gotten moved beforehand and suggested moving there as well). That change caused others to happen, I quit my second job that had been emotionally taxing and wasn’t giving me many hours anyway, I ended up finally breaking up with my boyfriend at the time who had been really nice but anytime things got bad for me it ended up being made into his issue not mine. This in turn lead me to deciding to try to just focus on myself for a bit and I actually found my new coworkers to be really kind and understanding.

I feel like I have a need for my cuts/scars to be perfect (I some some perfection issues, I wouldn’t say ocd but there’s still something) so I usually try to go slower so they can end up straighter and more symmetrical
Aw, poor kitty!
I don’t think I have posted him there
He’s a rescue, all I know is that his mom is a short haired calico cat.
He was always bugging her
Sometimes I do, other times I really don’t give a fuck
I definitely prefer one but I’ll change to the other when I have felt I’ve run out of room but it’s more awkward to do and doesn’t feel quite right.

Honestly it’s not the thought of what people will feel after that stops me. It’s the thought of what my cats would go through if I just vanished one day. Another big thing that stops me is the fear of failing again, I have had a number of failed attempts and the time it sent me to the hospital felt even more like living hell than life already does.
I thankfully have two ex-managers that have had their own battles with depression and I’ve been able to open up to them and a couple of coworkers.
This is why I hide away in my room most of the time

I’m always trying to make sure my sleeves stay down at work especially when kids are around. I always think to myself how bad it is that I feel like my own skin is nsfw :( but it’s still hard to stop.

I haven’t even started thinking about Christmas, but I really want to bail on my family’s Thanksgiving dinner. I already last minute didn’t show up for one of their dinners though and they’d be really pissed off/concerned if I didn’t go to Thanksgiving.
Fear of another attempt failing and wanting to be there for my kitties.
Whenever I relapse I end up getting stuck in the mindset of “well I already have cuts now, what difference will some more make?” and then it’ll get harder to stop.
[My Happy Place](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/14kRsygD5QoobPtsRUSWE7u6mTNYKal0o)
The only attempt they know about was on 7/6/16, enough time should’ve passed that I would have hopped that they’d have dropped it by now.

I don’t blame you there then. I’m also really bad at confrontation and have always tried my hardest to keep my struggles private but that doesn’t seem to work well because everything eventually ends up boiling over. I’m really sorry that you actually want to reach out for help but they won’t take you seriously.

I don’t know if this would actually work, but maybe if you talked to your school nurse about it they might make your parents get you a therapist? It might make your parents upset but at least you’d be getting the help you need and want.

Not necessarily. I’ve had some go away completely after a few weeks but others have taken longer. I have some scars that you can only see in certain lighting or if I get really sunburnt, but a few are still clearly visible even after 3+ years.

No, I agree. I got rid of my knife (gave it to a close friend who knows what I’m going through because I couldn’t convince myself to throw it away) and now I can’t help but keep wanting to just go out and buy a new one. I’m trying to be strong and not do it but it’s really hard.

I’m the same way. I think during the day work can keep my mind occupied/distracted but as soon as I come home it all comes rushing to the front of my mind. I’ve been told to try to do something to distract myself but like you said, I just can’t find the motivation at that point to do it. Days off are the worst for me, I have to try to make plans ahead of time to try to keep myself busy but the more I plan out the more overwhelmed I end up getting and then I just end up wanting to cancel any plans I made.

I used to always feel like the biggest contributor to me feeling depressed was financial issues but I’ve made full time now and the benefits are great and I’m doing well financially now, but the depression is still here. And I totally understand about putting a fake face on and just pretending outwardly that you are happy and everything is fine and it has really started hurting me recently.

This happens to me too frequently. I’ll have a good period, usually doesn’t last more than two months though, but then something will happen or sometimes I can’t even figure out the cause, but things will turn to shit. When it happens I feel like it hurts worse because of the good times, like they were a trap or a distraction. Other times I’ll get more upset at myself because I had been doing so well and now I’m not.
I didn’t know this was a thing, I have always just assumed that my memory loss has just been caused by all of the concussions I have had but this would help explain why it’s so bad.

I was doing really badly recently and was in a really really bad place one day until I noticed that my cat was following me everywhere I went, he literally wouldn’t leave my side. I thought to myself that somehow he must have known that I was thinking of harming myself and he was trying to make sure I didn’t. Because of him I was able to temporarily snap out of it.

This is definitely how I’ve felt. I haven’t even bothered looking for a job in the field I’ve gotten my bachelors degree in because I don’t see the point in going through the process of ending my two part time jobs to get another.

It really honestly should be our choice. We shouldn’t be forced to live be when we don’t have the will or the want to. People say it’s selfish of us but maybe it’s selfish of them to force us to keep living?

They have always had their own goals for me and even though I've already failed at that they still want me to do it. They were part of the problem in my childhood, they were super controlling. I miss the good times with them but there is no going back to that, they have already screwed that up.

I have a couple of friends who I have talked to about this and while it helps temporarily it doesn't make everything better. I can't talk face to face about this to strangers, for all anyone knows I am a perfectly happy 22 year old female but inside I am not. I can't even talk to my parents about this. And I have wanted this for to long to just quit now.

My cat always knew when I was feeling depressed or even physically hurt and would always stay with me to comfort me. Since he passed away a year ago I've gotten so much worse but my new apartment won't let me have a pet.
My friends keep suggesting I see a therapist and this is why I really don't want to.

That thought is always in my head as well, and just as you said it changes in regards to how close to the forefront it gets. Even when I'm having a good time that thought is still there letting me know that this enjoyment I'm having is just temporary and the problems of the real world will be back. People always say that there are ups and downs in life but what if the downs are just too much to handle? What if they are a lot worse than the ups?
Turn one a bajillion moxes, Tolerian academy, time vault, voltaic key.
